selection.policy: Minimum calibration mean width among simultaneously HB-certified quantile pairs. Bonferroni across all endpoint candidates; total tail-risk UCB <= alpha. No fixed tail allocation or q-gap. No test selection.

primary.endpoint_policy: Clipped quantile predictions anchored to the median: LB=min(Q(q_lower),Q(.5)), UB=max(Q(q_upper),Q(.5)); no interval multiplication. Global q pair per camera, spatially varying predicted bounds.
primary.selection_policy: 36 endpoint candidates fixed before calibration, 324 pairs; simultaneous image-level HB UCBs with delta/36. Select minimum calibration width subject to sum of tail-risk UCBs <= .1. Test labels never used in selection.
primary.limitation: Finite-grid search, not a continuous global optimum. Simultaneous search certificate is more conservative than the old two-tail scaling certificate. Guarantees require independent calibration images and matching calibration/test distribution. Weights unchanged; median reconstruction unchanged.

selection.policy: Fixed-sequence HB tests in predeclared q order, broad to narrow. Stop at first failure per tail; choose last passing q. Alpha/2 and delta/2 per tail. No test selection.

asymmetric.endpoint_policy: Clipped quantile predictions anchored to the median: LB=min(Q(q_lower),Q(.5)), UB=max(Q(q_upper),Q(.5)); no interval multiplication. Global q pair per camera, spatially varying predicted bounds.
asymmetric.selection_policy: Fixed-sequence HB tests in predeclared q order, broad to narrow. Stop at first failure per tail; choose last passing q. Alpha/2 and delta/2 per tail. No test selection.
asymmetric.limitation: Finite-grid search, not a continuous global optimum. Simultaneous search has an additional multiplicity penalty; fixed-sequence stops at the first failed tail test. Guarantees require independent calibration images and matching calibration/test distribution. Weights unchanged; median reconstruction unchanged.
